body.name: cardinality-uniform latent-overlap POMDP conditional-moment experiment class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_T(t_0,\zeta,C):=\{(\mathcal X,\mathcal H,\mathcal A,K,b,e,\mathcal L(\mathsf O_T)):T\in\mathbb N,\ 1\le|\mathcal X|,|\mathcal H|,|\mathcal A|<\infty,\text{ and }\mathrm A_{\mathrm{pomdp}},\mathrm A_{\mathrm{ign}},\mathrm A_{\mathrm{start}},\mathrm A_{\mathrm{mom}},\mathrm A_{\mathrm{act}},\mathrm A_{\mathrm{mix}},\mathrm A_{\mathrm{stat}}\text{ hold}\}\), where the seven predicates are exactly \(\mathrm{ass{:}pomdp\text{-}kernel}\) through \(\mathrm{ass{:}latent\text{-}stationary\text{-}overlap}\), with \(\mathrm A_{\mathrm{mom}}\) denoting the replaced conditional-moment envelope.  The union ranges over all finite cardinalities and all revealed policy pairs; \(M_1,M_2\) are fixed class constants, and the latent alphabet, kernel, and stationary laws are unknown.
